Vehicles approaching from his right and left to stop.

options.text: Drivers from his left, front and rear to go.
Drivers from his left, front and rear to stop.
Drivers from his right, front and behind to stop.

options.text: He intends to make a U-turn.
He intends to go around the round-about.
He intends to move to the left or turn to the left.

Motorcyclist seen from behind with arm held out to the right, bent and moving up and down
Motorcyclist seen from behind with arm stretched straight out to the left of the picture
